properties.name: Odin
properties.description: Allfather of the Norse gods. Sacrificed an eye at Mimir's well for wisdom and hung on Yggdrasil for nine days to gain the runes.

properties.name: Thor
properties.description: God of thunder, protector of humanity and the gods. Wielded Mjölnir, the hammer. Strongest of the Aesir. Fated to die fighting Jörmungandr.

properties.name: Loki
properties.description: The trickster god, blood-brother of Odin. Shape-shifter who caused mischief ranging from amusing to catastrophic. Father of Fenrir, Hel, and Jörmungandr.

properties.name: Freyja
properties.description: Vanir goddess of love, fertility, and seiðr magic. Claimed half of battle-slain for her hall Fólkvangr. Most beautiful of the goddesses. Wept golden tears.

properties.name: Fenrir
properties.description: Monstrous wolf, son of Loki. Bound by the gods with magical chain Gleipnir. Destined to break free at Ragnarök and devour Odin.

properties.name: Jörmungandr
properties.description: World-encircling sea serpent, child of Loki. Biting its own tail around Midgard. Will release at Ragnarök to fight Thor.

properties.name: Frigg
properties.description: Queen of the Aesir, wife of Odin. Goddess of marriage and motherhood. She knows all fates but tells none. Friday named after her.

properties.name: Tyr
properties.description: God of law, justice, and honorable warfare. Sacrificed his hand to bind Fenrir. Tuesday named after him. Bravest of the gods.

properties.name: Hel
properties.description: Daughter of Loki, ruler of the realm of the dead (also called Hel). Half alive, half corpse. Received those who died of illness or old age.

properties.name: Balder
properties.description: Most beloved of the Norse gods, son of Odin and Frigg. Beautiful and pure. Killed by mistletoe. His death heralds Ragnarök.

properties.name: Heimdall
properties.description: Guardian of Bifrost, the rainbow bridge. Born of nine mothers. Can hear grass grow and see for hundreds of miles. Will blow Gjallarhorn at Ragnarök.

properties.name: Njörðr
properties.description: Vanir god of the sea, wind, and wealth. Father of Freyja and Freyr. Patron of sailors and fishermen. Married the giantess Skadi.

properties.name: Freyr
properties.description: Vanir god of fertility, sunshine, and rain. Twin brother of Freyja. Gave up his sword for love. Will be among the first to fall at Ragnarök.
